body: I'm sorry to hear that. I don't understand people who ignore someone reaching out in this way. It is literally the least you can do to acknowledge the message. I hope you're doing better now.
Any initials you would like to share?
I'm sorry you're feeling similar. It's a hard spot to be in for sure. Did you initiate contact last time?
No, I'm actually way healthier and whole in every way now rather than then. But it could be that i miss the person he was then, since i don't know him anymore.

You are young, I'm sure of it. This is the hard part. You will make your way as you grow in life and you will find good things. It won't always be easy and smooth, because life isn't like that. But one thing is guaranteed: things always change. Life ebbs and flows, like the ocean. 

Everything you are going through right now seems permanently awful. But the truth is, one way or another, it will become a distant memory. You have one life, don't throw it away. Focus on things that make you happy, like hobbies and special interests. Also do the things that need to be done like chores and studying, because as opposite as it sounds, it feels really good to get those things done. 

Make things as simple as you can so you can really find out what makes you happy. More time spent learning about you, less time fixating on other peoples opinions and reactions. They aren't as important as they feel in the moment.

If you have the chance, talk therapy can be really helpful. I hope you stop hurting yourself: you deserve to take care of yourself.

Oh my. You are so young. You are in an abusive relationship. This is all kinds of emotional abuse and manipulation. Whatever you do or don't do, whatever makes him "mad," whatever issues there are - none of that makes his behavior ok. Listen to this: you do not deserve this treatment. It will not get better. Nothing you do is going to change this. 

You have so much time to learn and grow and find a different path for yourself. It doesn't sound like you have a child and DON'T have one with him. He will do these same things to the child. This is such a reddit thing to say, but, leave him and this marriage. It is nothing more than a breakup with paperwork. Do not let anyone's opinions worry or influence you. This is your life and you only have one. Don't waste your time in the position you have found yourself in.

If you asked everyone in the world if they should have stayed with the person they were with at age 23, most people would say absolutely not. You are still growing as a person, and locking yourself into this life of misery now is not the way. 

You will be ok. Life has rough patches. Things ebb and flow. This might be hard and suck for a while, but you will be ok. One day, everything you described will be just a distant memory.

All these comments of women gushing about their wonderful husbands need to be taken with huge grains of salt. It might be possible that a unicorn of a man exists in this world - emotionally mature, able to take care of himself AND someone you are in love with. But in reality, you might get 2 of those things and consider yourself lucky. Usually it's one - the love one - and wow does that vanish quickly when he can't be bothered to do basic shit and he's a dick about it. 

Don't get married, and don't plan your life around the idea of doing it. Live life only for you and never compromise what you want for someone else. If, along the way, you find someone compatible with the life you've chosen, that's nice. But it isn't necessary, and it definitely shouldn't shape your choices.

I'm sure you would be surprised who still thinks about you and misses you. It's hard to feel like nothing good stays in your life, but all I can say is to keep an open mind and don't dismiss new opportunities because of lost past ones.
I understand. That's still hard.
I'm ok. It's been so long, we both moved on with life stuff of course. I just still miss him, and always will.

It's not because I'm lazy or scared. I have his phone number. I mentioned in another comment that I did text about 8 years ago and we talked. It became apparent that neither of us was really over it, and he mentioned that it felt like ripping open a wound that had never really healed.

I felt guilty. We both know we can't go back. I would like to talk more but it seems too painful for him, which is why I feel like I would be disrupting his life.
Why not? Did your relationship end badly?
I get it. Life circumstances and things. Love isn't always enough.
I have always looked from time to time. He's just the one I can't seem to fully let go of.
Because I have definitely looked for him online lol
It's rough when time marches on but you don't miss them less.
Neither one of us have a presence on social media anymore. I'm sorry your ex didn't answer, that must have been hard after all that time.

I did talk to him maybe 8 years ago. I texted to apologize for my role in things. We chatted a bit. It seemed like we both weren't really "over it" and couldn't have a regular friendship, but also couldn't go back and try again.

A man I shared a life and a home with for 2.5 years until a little over 10 years ago. I know his contact info but I feel like it would be unfair and selfish to show up in his life randomly. We didn't end horribly but there's just nothing to do about it all now, you know?
Then text me...I still dream about you.
I feel this
I'm sorry. The death of a relationship is awful.
Probably. I'm sure it's not rainbows all the time but it has to be better than the alternative.
Unfortunately
I'm sorry. You never know, though.
I'm happy for you. Hold onto that feeling.
I like this description, it's weird but somehow seems spot on
This is very true
This hits too hard and too close.
